source_context: Sandbox historical replay evidence pilot for Singapore petrochemicals manufacturing movements.
evidence_items: Singapore petrochemicals output in 2022 was influenced by petrochemical demand, chemical demand, and downstream industrial activity.
Petrochemical production reflected movements in basic chemicals, specialty chemicals, and regional manufacturing demand.
Feedstock prices and naphtha prices affected petrochemical margins and production decisions during the year.
Chemical plant and petrochemical plant utilisation shaped output patterns as producers responded to demand and cost conditions.
